channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 18 November
item.description: Revised blockchain network plans after feedback and added new test scenarios, along with updated phase documentation. Fixed cursor‑based pagination and added tests for the SDK, plus minor documentation tweaks. Added evidence matrices and related tests to the blockchain component. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 17 November
item.description: Advanced research phases and added a pattern map in the blockchain network, while creating detailed phase plans. Introduced durability checks and related tests in the blockchain component. Added overrides and role seeds to the SDK, and improved third‑party resolution handling in a build template. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, cmaketemplate, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 16 November
item.description: Corrected a summary and updated plans for the blockchain network, recording recent merge actions. Fixed a merge issue in the blockchain component and aligned test cases for storage markers. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius.

item.title: GNUS digest — Sunday 15 November
item.description: Inserted temporary diagnostic messages into the wallet verification process and improved those diagnostics. Repositories: GeniusWallet.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 14 November
item.description: Added a roadmap outlining seven phases for the upcoming milestone. Revised the backup system description to support a tiered archive and light node model. Repositories: GeniusNetwork.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 13 November
item.description: Removed an old GQHSM component from the cognitive system and updated documentation accordingly. Enhanced backup and storage tracking in the blockchain network. Repositories: GeniusCognitiveSystem, GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GNUS-NEO-SWARM.
